shoreDistance.distanceGeometry: distance inside wet union to physical wet/dry boundaries, including island holes; dissolve internal source and lock semantic partitions; do not treat clip-box edges as shores
shoreDistance.waterMask: only actual v3 water union; no box-minus-mainland sea or southern-ocean completion
shoreDistance.invalidBoundaryPolicy: tag crop edges and use uncut fixed-source continuation or explicitly omit crop edges from physical-shore distance; do not fabricate foam at bbox
shoreDistance.generation: exact Euclidean distance in game units or resolution-bound raster distance with anisotropic pixel sampling; legacy repeated erosion is not a calibrated Euclidean field
shoreDistance.qualityGate: 8192 option still needs maxTextureSize/memory/frame tests; 4096 option is 5.2 game/texel and cannot be accepted as preserving all 1.5-6 game shoreline detail. For low-memory targets propose local high-resolution distance clipmap as a separate runtime change.
